run_GoalFollower_agent: run the GoalFollower agent benchmark using the CLI with --agent-class GoalFollower
run_RandomForward_agent: run the RandomForward agent benchmark with 80 percent forward probability via CLI
run_ForwardOnly_agent: run the ForwardOnly agent that only moves forward until the goal is reached
run_RandomAgent_benchmark: run the RandomAgent benchmark that randomly chooses move forward turn left or turn right
run_simple_agents_cli: run the simple agents CLI with --task-config and --success-distance arguments
